title: Comfort

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Comfort level determines the duration of Resting Effect. Minimum duration is 8 minutes (at 1 comfort), with each additional comfort level stacking 1 minute up to 24 minutes with usual items and 26 minutes with rare seasonal items.
The max comfort reachable normally is 17. If near a Maypole 18 or with the seasonal Yule tree 19.
When entering most dungeons (such as Burial Chambers), a campfire can be constructed to easily gain Comfort 3 (and a 10-minute Rested effect).
Note that while the player can add more than one furniture item from the categories below, only the one with the highest comfort will influence the comfort rating.

sections.heading: Comfort level breakdown

sections.heading: Maximum comfort per biome
sections.text:
This table highlights comfort items discoverable within each biome, illustrating the progression of potential comfort levels. Biomes themselves do not directly affect comfort level – only the comfort items placed.
Seasonal items are not included in this table; when they are available, they each add +1 comfort for a potential total bonus of +2 comfort. Both seasonal items are obtainable with Meadows-level gear, but both will require visiting a Black Forest.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
Items must be within ten meters of the character to add comfort.
The following furniture are needed for maximum comfort level:
• 17 comfort (24 minutes): Any throne (3), Dragon bed (2), Any Darkwood table (Round or Long = 2), Hot tub (Heated = 2), Hearth (2), Armor stand (1), Lava lantern (1), any rug (1), any banner (1), and (sheltered = 2).
• 19 comfort (26 minutes): All of the above plus Maypole and Yule tree, which are seasonal items.
Furniture center points:
• Bed, Dragon bed, Hearth: Bottom of the object.
• Bonfire, Campfire: Center of the unlit object.
• Hanging brazier: Top of the object.
• Hot tub: Horizontally slightly towards the chimney, vertically where the chimney starts.
• Yule tree: Almost top of the object.
• Center of the object for everything else.
